articles.title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
articles.snippet: Blur will close its website on Nov. 12 after monthly trading fell from about $1.43 billion at its 2023 peak to under $7 million, ten days after sister project Blast announced its own shutdown.

articles.title: Anthropic warns ‘AI worms’ may autonomously spread across devices like a virus
articles.snippet: Anthropic warned that rogue “AI worms” are months away from the ability to self-replicate and autonomously infect user devices such as home appliances and other internet-connected devices.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops 2.2% as Ukraine, Iran strikes send oil toward one-month high
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price action stayed rangebound after failing to sustain above $84,000 into the Wall Street open on rising oil prices.

articles.title: Strive Buys $280 Million in Bitcoin, Its Largest Purchase in Months
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq-listed asset manager bought the Bitcoin at an average of about $84,500 during a rough week for the market, lifting its total stash to 32,773 BTC.

articles.title: NFT Marketplace Blur to Shut Down Website, Stop New Blend Loans Next Month
articles.snippet: The shutdown comes as NFT trading volumes have collapsed from their 2021-2022 peak, with market revenue projected at $318 million this year.
